description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Bonny Pall, adding {C}{C}. 
When Bonny Pall dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Bonny from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it. 
When Bonny Pall enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a */* Beau legendary creature token. 
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Beau, adding {C}{C}. 
Repeat.
